guarantees.claim: When EnMasking==0, err_entropy_ready is tied to 1'b0.
When EnMasking==0, cfg_entropy_ready is tied to 1'b1.
unused_cfg_entropy_ready is driven continuously equal to cfg_entropy_ready (hence always 1) when EnMasking==0.

assumptions.claim: External logic correctly interprets err_entropy_ready=0 as 'no entropy ready error' and cfg_entropy_ready=1 as 'entropy source always ready' when EnMasking=0.
assumptions.cond: When EnMasking=0 and these outputs are consumed elsewhere in the design.
assumptions.risk: If misinterpreted, false error handling or incorrect handshake may occur.

uncertain_points.claim: Signal unused_cfg_entropy_ready is declared and assigned but has no further usage in this chunk; its purpose (lint workaround, future placeholder, or accidental dead code) is unclear.
uncertain_points.risk: If it is dead code, no functional risk but it may obscure intent. If it was intended as a stub for a port later consumed, missing connection could lead to an undriven net elsewhere.
